blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s unexplained wealth from 2022 to 2025 could reach as much as P1.5 billion, forensic financial analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera alleged Monday. Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero, who presided over the impeachment court proceedings, asked Cabrera how much of Duterte’s wealth might have remained undeclared if he had not taken a “conservative” approach in analyzing her financial records. “If you are not conservative … in your expertise, and based on your review of the documents, what is the maximum amount?” Escudero asked.
